name: Handles, Pull-Ups & Defense
summary: Tighten your handle in a small space, finish off the wrong foot, pull up off a curl and finish with a defensive slide circuit.

drills.name: Tight Box Dribble Series
drills.summary: Keep the ball tight and your eyes up while moving in a small space.
steps: Set 4 cones in a box about two steps wide.
Dribble around the box in a low stance, right hand going one way.
At each cone, hit a crossover and keep moving.
Switch directions and lead with your left hand.
Last minute: pick a move at each cone (cross, between, behind).

drills.name: Wrong-Foot Layups
drills.summary: Finish off the 'wrong' foot to throw off the shot blocker's timing.
steps: Start on the right wing and attack the rim with two dribbles.
Jump off your right foot and finish with your right hand.
Do 5 makes, then switch to the left side and go off your left foot.
Last round, mix regular and wrong-foot finishes.

drills.name: Cone Curl Pull-Ups
drills.summary: Curl tight around a screen and rise into a balanced pull-up.
steps: Put a cone at the free-throw line extended as your screen.
Start on the wing and dribble hard toward the cone.
Curl tight around it, shoulder close to the cone.
Square up with a hop or a 1-2 stop and shoot at the elbow.
Do both sides, 5 shots each, and track your makes.

drills.name: Five-Cone Defensive Star
drills.summary: Slide, close out and recover in every direction to build defensive legs.
steps: Set one cone in the middle and four cones around it, about 4 steps out.
Start at the middle in a stance and slide out to the first cone.
Touch it, then backpedal or slide back to the middle.
Go to every cone around the star, then reverse the order.
Work 40 seconds, rest 20, and repeat four rounds.
